def: to associate; by implication, to overshadow (by huddling together)

occurrences.text: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.

The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chesnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
